snippet.title: GRADIUS ORIGINS Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
'GRADIUS ORIGINS' the 40th anniversary title for the GRADIUS series is out now! 

GRADIUS ORIGINS features 6 popular titles with a total of 17 versions from the series, including the Gradius III AM Show Version being ported for the first time ever for home consoles, and an all-new entry to the series, SALAMANDER III!
